_comment: Small FAQ knowledge base used by the retrieval node for general_question intent. Searched with the same rank_bm25 engine used in the rag-citation-demo / multi-agent-financial-qa projects, for consistency across the portfolio.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as they are unused and in original packaging.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-7 business days domestically and 7-14 business days internationally.

faqs.question: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as the order hasn't shipped yet. Once an order has shipped, the address on file can no longer be changed.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: You'll receive a tracking link by email once your order ships. You can also provide your order ID to check status at any time.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds for damaged items?
faqs.answer: Yes, damaged or defective items are eligible for a full refund or replacement regardless of the return window, once reported with a description of the issue.

faqs.question: How long do refunds take to process?
faqs.answer: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to most countries. International orders may be subject to customs fees determined by the destination country.
